title: BAKUGAN GALACTIC VENTRI Special Attack Gen 3 Wave 1 Galactic Chase 2023 - NEW!
descriptionText:
This is a special attack Bakugan Battle Brawlers action figure of Ventri from the Galactic Chase 2023 collection. It is made of plastic and has a scale of 1:12. The figure is multicolored and comes in a boxed package. 

It features the character Nillious and is an original licensed reproduction from the Bakugan franchise. The toy is suitable for children aged 3 and above and is a great addition to any collection. Get your hands on this rare chase figure and add it to your Bakugan collection today!
